retrievalProfile.description: A dark, cinematic portrait featuring a central figure on a plastic-draped throne holding a reflective orb with vibrant red script in the lower corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, high-contrast photograph of a man seated on a chair covered in translucent yellow plastic sheeting, set within a dark, ornate gothic room. He holds a large chrome sphere in his right hand. The scene is anchored by a vibrant red, expressive script title in the bottom right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure framed by the triangular peak of the plastic-draped chair
Reflective chrome sphere contrasting with the matte, dark textures of the room
Vibrant red script cutting through the dark, desaturated background
Symmetrical architectural elements of the fireplace framing the subject
coreInvariants: Translucent plastic sheeting draped over the seating
Reflective metallic sphere held as a prop
Deep shadows with warm, localized highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and occupies the middle vertical third, scaled to appear dominant within the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white sneakers at the bottom and the reflective sphere on the left create a visual triangle with the subject's head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the reflective sphere, moves to the subject's face, down the body to the white shoes, and finally to the red script in the corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the upper corners and floor areas provide breathing room for the complex textures of the plastic and clothing.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks provide a moody, gothic foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Translucent yellow/gold from the plastic sheeting provides mid-tone contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant crimson red for the typography and bright white for the footwear.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights on reflective surfaces and high-saturation accents in the text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with long, expressive ascenders and descenders.
letterConstructionRules: Rapid, gestural strokes with varying pressure
Connected lowercase letters with exaggerated flourishes on capitals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' and 'Y' feature extended tails that create horizontal movement across the composition.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used as a signature element against a photographic background.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, raw energy of the original lettering.
Captures the urban, street-style influence of the subject.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in dark streetwear and white sneakers sitting on a chair covered in translucent yellow plastic in a dark gothic room, holding a chrome orb.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom red handwritten script in the bottom right corner with sharp, energetic strokes.

verificationChecks: Is the plastic sheeting translucent and yellow-toned?
Is the red script placed in the bottom right corner?
Does the subject hold a reflective sphere?
Is the lighting low-key and moody?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red in the text
Level of detail in the gothic background
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the clothing
Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text is vibrant and legible against the dark background.
Check that the plastic drape has realistic highlights and shadows.
Verify the chrome sphere reflects the surrounding environment.
Confirm the white sneakers act as a strong visual base.
recipe.reuseFormula: Gothic interior + plastic-draped furniture + reflective prop + vibrant script overlay = Cinematic Urban Portrait
